core.title: Soho Lever with 3 Piece Square Rose, Karcher UERQ57

text.description_html:
Karcher UERQ57 Soho Lever with 3 Piece Square Rose

From Karcher Design, this modern 3 Piece Square Rose exemplifies the unique design aesthetic of the brand. The Soho lever incorporates clean lines with an unexpected curve making this a standout example of their cutting edge style. 304 grade stainless steel construction makes it a durable and stylish choice. It will fit standard 2-1/8 inch cut-outs and comes with either 2-3/8 inch or 2-3/4 inch backsets. Available in either satin stainless steel or cosmos black finish.

Features of the Soho Stainless Steel Leverset:

  • Fits standard door cut outs (2-1/8" pre-drilled doors)
  • Field reversible tubular latch
  • Premium latch requires only 28° rotation to retract latchbolt
  • Strike: Both T Strike and Full Lip Strike included
  • Concealed Screw Mounting
  • 304 Stainless Steel Construction
  • Meets standards of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA)

Specifications of the KAR-UERQ57 Soho Stainless Steel Lever With Square 3 Piece Rose:

  • Material: 304 Stainless Steel
  • Lever Length: 5-1/16"
  • Lever Dimensions: 11/16" x 3/8"
  • Spindle Width: 8 mm
  • Rose Height: 2-5/8" Square
  • Rose Thickness:7/16"
  • Door Thickness: adjustable for 1-3/16" - 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"

When Selecting a Function:

  • Single Dummy: For use as a door pull or to match trim. Trim is on one side of door. Lever is surface mounted (mounting plate screws to the doors face).
  • Double Dummy: No door latch. Door levers on both sides of the door. For use with a standard 2-1/8" bore hole pre-drilled door.
  • Passage (hall or closet): For doors that don't need locking. Latch operates from either side of door.
  • Privacy (bedroom or bathroom): For doors that could need privacy locking. Latch operates from either side. Push button on interior rose engages privacy; emergency release hole is on exterior rose. Turning inside lever will release privacy push button and retract the door latch.

Note: Single Dummy is Handed. All other functions are non-handed. Handing Guide
